norms.reply.formal.approved.body:
{{supplier}}
To the Procurement Department

Subject: Approval of the proposed material substitution
Project: «{{pname}}»

Following our review of your proposal to substitute «{{from}}» with «{{to}}», we hereby notify you of the following.

1. The proposed option meets the project requirements and applicable standards.
2. The substitution additionally reduces project cost.
3. On the above grounds, the substitution is APPROVED.

Please provide an invoice and delivery schedule.

Respectfully,
{{engineerFormalName}}
Lead Project Engineer
norms.reply.formal.rejected.body:
{{supplier}}
To the Procurement Department

Subject: Rejection of the proposed material substitution
Project: «{{pname}}»

Following our review of your proposal to substitute «{{from}}» with «{{to}}», we hereby notify you of the following.

1. The project specifies certain requirements which the proposed option does not meet.
2. On the above grounds, the substitution is REJECTED.

We request that you submit an alternative proposal that fully matches the project specification.

Respectfully,
{{engineerFormalName}}
Lead Project Engineer
norms.reply.polite.approved.body:
Dear colleagues at {{supplier}},

Thank you sincerely for proposing the substitution of «{{from}}» with «{{to}}» on «{{pname}}» — a great cost-optimisation initiative.

After a careful review of the documentation, we are glad to confirm the substitution is APPROVED: the proposal fully meets the project requirements and additionally reduces cost.

We would appreciate an invoice and delivery schedule.

With best regards,
{{engineerName}}
Lead Project Engineer
norms.reply.polite.rejected.body:
Dear colleagues at {{supplier}},

First of all, thank you sincerely for your promptness and for proposing the substitution of «{{from}}» with «{{to}}» on «{{pname}}». We greatly appreciate your attention to the project budget.

Unfortunately, after a careful review of the project documentation, we are not able to approve this substitution — the proposal does not meet certain project requirements.

We would be most grateful if you could consider an alternative; we will be glad to review it without delay.

Thank you again for your cooperation.

With best regards,
{{engineerName}}
Lead Project Engineer
